caseName: Commercial National Bank v. Custer County
caseNameFull: Commercial National Bank of Miles City, Montana, and W. M. Turner, Receiver v. Custer County and John E. deCarle, County Treasurer Same v. Same and Miles City National Bank of Miles City, Montana v. Same
attorneys: Mr. Charles H. Loud, with whom Messrs. George N. Brown and Lewis J. Wallace were on the brief, for plaintiffs in error. Messrs. Rudolph Nelstead and A. H. Angstman, with whom Mr. L. A. Foot was on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed on the authority of First National Bank of Hartford v. Hartford, 273 U. S. 548, 559, 560; Minnesota v. First National Bank of St. Paul, 273 U. S. 561, 567, 568.
